title: AgentPeerBindingSignal
description: Category C — operational projection of the imagodei AgentPeerBinding DHT entry (Task A.1/A.2). Source-of-truth is the DHT-notarized AgentPeerBinding entry referenced by actionHash and by bindingActionHash (same value, named explicitly for semantic clarity). The stream message is reconstructable from the DNA. Emitted by the imagodei coordinator's create_agent_peer_binding function (Task A.9 — out of scope for A.3). The reconcile controller (Task A.4) uses this signal to update the local peer-binding projection table.

actionHash.description: Holochain ActionHash (base64) of the AgentPeerBinding DHT entry. Same value as bindingActionHash; present for uniform stream deserialization.

peerId.description: multibase-encoded libp2p PeerId of the bound peer. Stable network identity used by the libp2p swarm. Format: base58btc-encoded multihash (e.g. '12D3KooW...').

agentCid.description: CID of the agent (human or elohim) to which this peer is bound. Links the libp2p identity to the DHT identity.

validFrom.description: UTC timestamp from which this binding is valid. Bindings issued before a key rotation are not automatically invalidated; the controller must check key rotation events to determine effective validity.

validUntil.description: UTC timestamp at which this binding expires. Null means the binding has no declared expiry (valid indefinitely until superseded or revoked).

deviceArchetype.description: Hardware/deployment archetype of the bound device. DNA-notarized as part of the AgentPeerBinding entry (imagodei integrity zome).

bindingActionHash.description: The DHT ActionHash of the AgentPeerBinding entry — explicit semantic alias for actionHash. Consumers that specifically track binding provenance should use this field name.

emittedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the signal was emitted from the conductor post-commit hook.
